Synthetic fixtures and approved visual examples.

Phase 1 brings over the `testdata/mock/` corpus from the plugin repo with
provenance notices, then adds the structural cases listed in PLAN.md: nested
wrappers, inserted siblings, repetitions without unique labels, unrelated
documents, list/table restructuring, attribute-only changes, void/empty
elements, inline formatting, Unicode/entities, whitespace, malformed HTML,
deep nesting, and output-expansion cases.
